{{short description|Russian mathematician and mathematics educator}}
'''Ellina Grigorieva''' is a Russian mathematician and [[mathematics education|mathematics educator]] known for her books on mathematical [[problem solving]]. She is a professor in the [[Texas Woman's University]] Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, and an expert on [[control theory]] and its applications to [[epidemiology|the spread of disease]].{{r|profile}}

==Education and career==
Grigorieva was born in [[Moscow]], and educated at [[Moscow State University]].{{r|profile}}

==Books==
Grigorieva's problem-solving books include:
*''Methods of Solving Number Theory Problems'' (Birkhäuser, 2018){{r|ntp}}
*''Methods of Solving Sequence and Series Problems'' (Birkhäuser, 2016){{r|ssp}}
*''Methods of Solving Nonstandard Problems'' (Birkhäuser, 2015){{r|nsp}}
*''Methods of Solving Complex Geometry Problems'' (Birkhäuser, 2013){{r|cgp}}
